wiki.title: Jamie Smith (politician)
wiki.extract: Jamie R. Smith (born January 31, 1971) is an American politician and senator in the South Dakota Senate. A member of the Democratic Party, Smith represents District 15, which covers downtown Sioux Falls neighborhoods, including areas around Terrace Park and the Great Plains Zoo. He served as House Minority Leader of the South Dakota House of Representatives from 2019 to 2023.
